snip.t: *Abdominal distension and borborygmi:* Paralytic ileus induced by local intestinal wall inflammation and neurotoxins.
Paralytic ileus commonly produces reduced bowel sounds.
Nasogastric tube (paralytic ileus, aspiration), antiemetics, stress ulcer prophylaxis, thromboprophylaxis (high risk of DVT), analgesia (opioids then NSAIDs).

snip.t: Functional obstruction (paralytic ileus): Impaired peristalsis without a physical blockage, often due to abdominal surgery, peritonitis, electrolyte imbalances, or certain medications.
Functional obstruction (ileus): failure of normal peristalsis (e.g., paralytic ileus) without a true mechanical blockage, often due to disturbed neuromuscular coordination
